text:
Maya R.: Heads-up - found a streaming edge where quick reconnects cause duplicated final event in mobile sampleapp.
Jorge: oof. repro steps?
Maya R.: Start stream -> server sends large final chunk split across two TCP frames -> simulate 120ms network drop -> reconnect with Last-Event-ID -> server sometimes replays the split chunk as new event.
Ava: Does the SDK send canonical Last-Event-ID or lowercase? polyfills vary.
Maya R.: Mobile EventSource polyfill sends 'last-event-id' lowercase; node SDK sends both.
Tom B.: Our Go resume code reads r.Header.Get("Last-Event-Id") only. If proxy lowercased it, Get returns empty. That could trigger server to resend buffered fragments.
Jorge: Also check parser: if we treat an incomplete chunk as finished on EOF pre-reconnect, we may have already queued it.
Ava: Short fix: router middleware normalizes header keys to canonical 'Last-Event-Id' and parser should de-duplicate events by event-id on resume.
Maya R.: I'll open a small sampleapp PR to set both header casings on reconnect, and Tom can add middleware + unit test for mid-chunk EOF behavior.
ci-bot: build 4987 started for sampleapp/sse-reconnect-fix.
Tom B.: Will add an e2e that splits the final token across two TCP writes then forces a reconnect; assert single emission.
Maya R.: Thanks team, I'll add a note to SDK changelog for mobile integrators.
